securityInvariants: Bind HTTP/WS server strictly to 127.0.0.1 loopback (reject wildcard, LAN, and Tailscale binds).

Require mandatory fail-closed Cloudflare Access RS256 Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion verification against teamDomain, aud, and allowedEmails on HTTP, SSE, WebSocket, and static routes; no OVIS_TOKEN fallback.
Enforce OVIS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN on HTML/static responses, mutations, and WebSocket upgrades.
Bound admitted WebSocket and SSE connection lifetimes to verified JWT expiry/recheck hooks.
Keep OVIS_ACCOUNT_SERVICE_URL=off, OVIS_AUTO_UPDATE=0, relay/push-relay, and tailnet identity lookup disabled.
